description: Design matrix for the ix71 brightfield broom path: speed x exposure x detector width, with every infeasible point retained and its reason recorded. The feasibility limits are design placeholders, not acceptance limits.

camera.source: accepted crop900 hand-eye record camera mode (20 ms, 1200x1200, binning 1x1) and the MR095 reticle sampling 0.1823-0.1829 um/px

optics.source: no measured point-spread function exists; the sampling pitch is used only as a declared proxy, so blur_ratio is comparable across rows but is not an optical resolution result

sources.max_stage_speed_um_s: recorded 0.2 mm/s broom route (20261023T_specimen_broom_four_row_02_speed02); the profile default is 0.1 mm/s, not a ceiling
sources.min_frame_period_s: measured cadence 19.81 frames/s at 1200x1200 and 10 ms (20261023T_ix71_camera_cadence_matrix_01)
sources.min_observations: design placeholder, consistent with the plan's 20 percent overlap rule
